meaning_en: to screen someone's incoming calls
quote: I pushed all your calls because after the show you'll meet with the UBA PR team
quote_cn: 我把你的电话都推了，因为播完你还要见 UBA 公关部。
example: His assistant pushes all his calls before eleven.
example_cn: 助理在十一点前把他的电话都挡了。
note: 艺人/高管用语。push back a call＝推迟回电。

meaning_en: deliberately acting slowly to delay a decision
quote: the way that the network has been dragging their feet on closing my new deal
quote_cn: 电视台在我新约签约这事上一直拖着不办。
example: Procurement has been dragging its feet on the contract for weeks.
example_cn: 采购在合同上拖了好几周了。
note: 职场必备。反义 moving quickly / decisive。

word: have them by the short hairs
meaning_en: to have leverage over someone
quote: you have them by the short hairs now
quote_cn: 现在你把他们拿捏住了。
example: Once the client signed, we had them by the short hairs.
example_cn: 客户一签字，我们就拿住他了。
note: 抓住短发的说法，指完全控制局面。近义 have leverage。

meaning_en: to decide how a situation is publicly understood
quote: I just need to be able to control the narrative so that I'm not written out of it
quote_cn: 我只需要能掌控叙事，别让我被排除在外。
example: Announce it before the press finds out, or you lose the narrative.
example_cn: 要在媒体挖出来之前公布，否则叙事权就没了。
note: 公关/危机管理核心词。反义 lose the narrative。

meaning_en: excluded from something you were part of
quote: so that I'm not written out of it
quote_cn: 这样我不会被踢出局。
example: They quietly wrote him out of the partnership.
example_cn: 他们悄悄把他从合伙关系里剔除了。
note: write sb out of a deal/credit。字面「从剧本里划掉角色」。

meaning_en: a crowd waiting to exploit your mistake
meaning_cn: 一屋子等着看你出丑的人
quote: That event is gonna be a roomful of vultures waiting for you to fuck up
quote_cn: 那场活动就是一屋子等着你出丑的秃鹫。
example: Every quarterly review is a roomful of vultures.
example_cn: 每次季度考核都像一屋子秃鹫。
note: 比喻 voracious opportunists。vulture 本义秃鹫。

meaning_en: to cause extreme stress
quote: Why don't you just give me a stroke by 7:00?
quote_cn: 你干脆七点前把我吓出心脏病算了。
example: Don't give me a stroke, I'm fine.
example_cn: 别吓我了，我挺好的。
note: 夸张说法。真实语境中 stroke 指中风，务必分清。

meaning_en: to be a sensitive or awkward subject
quote: is fired for predatory behavior is touchy?
quote_cn: 在因性骚扰行为被开除后两天就去领奖，这事很敏感吧？
example: Compensation is always a touchy subject in reviews.
example_cn: 调薪在绩效评估里永远是敏感话题。
note: touchy＝敏感（话题）。反义 safe。

meaning_en: to hold your position despite pressure
quote: They're sticking to their guns.
quote_cn: 他们寸步不让。
example: Legal stuck to its guns on the indemnity clause.
example_cn: 法务在赔偿条款上寸步不让。
note: 字面士兵坚持架枪位置。职场谈判常用。

meaning_en: to give in under pressure
quote: Did they cave?
quote_cn: 他们松口了吗？
example: They held out for three weeks and then caved.
example_cn: 他们硬撑了三周还是让步了。
note: 名词 the cave＝从对方那里得到的让步。

meaning_en: to resist or demand concessions
quote: Push back.
quote_cn: 顶回去。
example: Push back hard on the scope before you sign.
example_cn: 签字前在范围上狠狠顶一轮。
note: 同名词 pushback＝反对意见。职场高频。

meaning_en: happening at the planned time
quote: We're still on schedule.
quote_cn: 我们进度还是正常的。
example: Two dependencies slipped but we're still on schedule.
example_cn: 两个依赖延了，但进度仍在计划内。
note: 反义 behind schedule。schedule 美式读 /ˈskedʒuːl/。

meaning_en: the final check before going on air
quote: Last looks!
quote_cn: 最后检查！
example: Ten minutes to last looks, then we're live.
example_cn: 十分钟后最后检查，然后就直播。
note: 电视/演出行业术语。last look 也指「最后的眼神」。

meaning_en: updated script pages
quote: Revised pages.
quote_cn: 这是修订稿。
example: Do not go on air without the revised pages in hand.
example_cn: 手里没有修订稿就别上直播。
note: 出版与广播通用。a page＝一张稿纸（一页≈一小时节目）。

meaning_en: your promise
quote: I need your word that you will wrap up my negotiation
quote_cn: 我需要你承诺会把我的谈判收尾。
example: Give me your word and I'll back you publicly.
example_cn: 给我个承诺，我就公开支持你。
note: 英式用法；美式更常说 give me your word／I have your word。

meaning_en: to finish a deal or a piece of work
quote: you will wrap up my negotiation
quote_cn: 你会把我的谈判收尾。
example: Legal wrapped up the contract on Friday.
example_cn: 法务周五把合同敲定了。
note: 职场比 finish 更自然。wrap＝收拢、包装。

meaning_en: into chaos or reversal
quote: The whole Mitch thing has turned everything upside down
quote_cn: Mitch 那件事把一切都搅乱了。
example: The reorg turned the whole roadmap upside down.
example_cn: 这次重组把整个路线图全打乱了。
note: 比 the wrong way up 更强调彻底颠倒。

meaning_en: direct personal involvement
quote: I would like hands-on control from this point on
quote_cn: 从现在起我要求亲自掌控。
example: After two co-CEOs she took hands-on control.
example_cn: 两位联席 CEO 之后她亲自接手掌控。
note: 反义 hands-off（放手不管）。副词也作 hands-on＝动手型的。

meaning_en: to do something attention-seeking for effect
quote: You pulling this stunt, with the network right now
quote_cn: 你现在跟电视台耍这一套。
example: Don't pull a stunt on the client without backing.
example_cn: 没把握就别在客户面前搞噱头。
note: stunt＝特技；引申为博眼球的动作。negative publicity。

meaning_en: to appear mentally unstable
quote: make them think you are fucking losing it
quote_cn: 只会让他们觉得你疯了。
example: The walkout made them think he was losing it.
example_cn: 那次罢工让他们觉得他精神出了问题。
note: 此处指「看起来不正常」，字面 lose 掉。注意与 lose one's temper 区分。

meaning_en: to be promoted through the levels
quote: We came up the ranks together.
quote_cn: 我们是一起一步步升上来的。
example: She came up the ranks before running the division.
example_cn: 她是一步步升上来才管这个部门的。
note: 常暗示「不是空降的」。rank＝职级。

meaning_en: through good and bad times alike
quote: For better, for worse.
quote_cn: 不论顺境逆境。
example: We signed up for each other, for better or worse.
example_cn: 我们彼此承诺，不論顺逆。
note: 源自婚礼誓词。婚姻用法最常见，职场/伙伴关系也用。

meaning_en: a position with no workable option
quote: you are putting me in an impossible situation
quote_cn: 你让我陷进了一个无法可解的处境。
example: Signing both contracts left us in an impossible situation.
example_cn: 两份合同都签了，让我们陷入两难。
note: put someone in an impossible position/spot。更口语是 catch-22。

meaning_en: to step in and cover someone's role
quote: I'm ready to fill in.
quote_cn: 我可以补上。
example: Alison filled in at five minutes' notice.
example_cn: Alison 在五分钟前临时顶了上来。
note: 此义是「顶替」，不是「填写」。fill in for someone。

meaning_en: in front of the public eye
quote: the first time you're in public since this whole thing happened
quote_cn: 这是这件事发生以来你第一次公开露面。
example: He avoided the press but went in public on the record.
example_cn: 他躲着媒体，却公开表态。
note: 公开讲＝in public；私下讲＝off the record。

meaning_en: to step forward publicly to give evidence
quote: These women who have come forward
quote_cn: 这些站出来的女性……
example: Two more employees came forward with complaints.
example_cn: 又有两名员工站出来投诉。
note: me-too 语境固定说法。特指站出来指控。

meaning_en: a role that lets you direct others
meaning_cn: 掌权的位置；有权威的角色
quote: You were in a position of authority.
quote_cn: 你当时处在有权力的位置。
example: As CTO he was in a position of authority over the team.
example_cn: 作为 CTO 他对团队有权威。
note: 职场/法律语境。in a position of authority 指上下级关系。

meaning_en: manicure and pedicure together
quote: get your car to take you for your mani-pedi
quote_cn: 让车送你去做美甲。
example: She booked a mani-pedi before the presentation.
example_cn: 她在汇报前预约了美甲。
note: 日常口语；正式场合分开说 manicure and pedicure。

meaning_en: a competing broadcast
quote: our shows are ratings rivals
quote_cn: 我们的节目是收视率上的对手。
example: The two networks are morning ratings rivals.
example_cn: 两家电视网是晨间时段的收视对手。
note: ratings＝收视率；rivals 此处形容词化。

meaning_en: to shake hands with people at an event
quote: Press the flesh.
quote_cn: 去握手寒暄吧。
example: He spent forty minutes pressing the flesh at the gala.
example_cn: 他在晚会上花了四十分钟逐一寒暄。
note: 政治/公关活动用语，带一点不耐烦的调侃。
